Testing popular apps, revealing how some collect and share information; what are they logging, and where is it going? Users watch their info leave their phones in real time, exposing a data trade they didn't realize they'd agreed to.
Andrew Chang goes beyond the headlines to explain the major news stories everybody is talking about.

An elderly woman was living alone when two men moved in. They quickly took over her life. She signed a will leaving them everything and then she died. Cases like this are on the rise, with sometimes deadly consequences.
